title: Beautiful !
text: Beautiful !. These are very beautiful butterflies. A nice set that is a good quality metal. The color, design and printing are very well done. Can use together or give as gifts.

product_metadata.title: khevga metal butterfly wall decor - butterfly wall decorations set of 3
features: Beautiful wall decoration: You are looking for a nice summer decoration or spring decoration? Then the khevga wall deco butterfly is just right for you.
High-quality metal: The decorative butterflies are made of metal. This metal is filigree punched, so that the metal butterflies have a particularly great look.
Set of 3: You get three butterflies in the set. The three butterflies are painted in different colors and are the same size.
Detailed painted: The wall decoration metal is painted in beautiful colors. In the set of 3 you get a greenish butterfly, a brownish butterfly and a reddish butterfly.
Dimensions: The country style deco butterfly has the dimensions about 9.45 x 7.5 inches.
